fast.change: Added an additional exclusion rule for directory parts ending in .egg-info.
fast.impact: Files within or named .egg-info directories will now be automatically skipped by the scanner.

detailed.change: The logic now dynamically checks each path component against a hardcoded string suffix pattern '.egg-info' using the str.endswith() method. This extends the existing set-based membership check for EXCLUDE_DIRS to include broader pattern matching for dependency-related metadata directories.
detailed.impact: This change reduces noise during file system traversal by preventing the inclusion of build-generated metadata. It ensures that virtual environment artifacts or distribution packages containing .egg-info folders are ignored, preventing redundant processing or potential permission errors in generated directories.
detailed.risk: The logic uses a robust string method that is unlikely to cause false positives for standard project structures. Since this is an exclusion filter, the worst-case scenario is skipping valid files, which is easily reversible and has a minimal functional impact on the system. Risk: low
